mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with haloperidol increases CNS depression, hypotension, and risk of hypertensive crisis via monoamine accumulation; haloperidol may lower seizure threshold when combined with MAOI.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution under close monitoring; if combination necessary, use lowest effective doses and monitor for hypertensive crisis, CNS depression, and serotonergic symptoms.
